about.title: How the calculator works
about.p1: Classic World uses the pre-Big Bang damage formula: weapon attack multiplies the whole result, your main stat is scaled by the weapon multiplier, and mastery raises your minimum damage. The calculator applies the community-verified formula published by NiaDB, adds critical hits, monster defense, elements, level gap and the hit roll, then runs your build against 40 monsters to rank training spots and upgrades.
faq.q1: What is the effective main stat?
faq.a1: It is the main stat a character with no secondary stat and no Attack Power would need, at the reference W.ATK, to match your average damage. Leave the reference empty to fold your secondary stat and AP into one number. Pin it to also count W.ATK upgrades as you progress.
faq.q2: How much is 1 W.ATK worth in STR, DEX or LUK?
faq.a2: It depends on your current stats. For a level 70 Fighter with 337 STR and 105 W.ATK, 1 W.ATK is worth about 4.2 STR and 1 Attack Power about 0.87 STR. The stat value table shows the numbers for your own character.
faq.q3: How much accuracy do I need?
faq.a3: Turn on a target monster. The calculator applies the hit formula with the level gap and shows the accuracy needed for a guaranteed hit. The monster accuracy table lists it for 40 popular monsters.
faq.q4: Can it load my character automatically?
faq.a4: No. Nexon's Open API does not cover GMS, so enter the values from your stat window. When the stat window range matches, your inputs are correct.
faq.a5: It reproduces NiaDB's worked examples exactly, such as the 59–172 range and the 154–449 Power Strike. The formulas are community measurements and can change with patches.
